title: Scholarship listing
description: One scholarship in data/scholarships.json (spec §7.2). Unknown = null or []. Unknown never disqualifies a student.

id.description: Stable slug. Real listings start with sch-, made-up ones with smp-sch-.

provider.description: Who gives the money. Made-up listings use made-up provider names only.

url.description: The listing's own page (where the student applies or reads the rules). Sample listings point to the placeholder page /sample-listing.

source_url.description: The page we extracted it from. null for sample listings.

focus_tags.description: Lowercase hooks the ranker can match on: robotics, food-insecurity, first-gen, credit-union, immigrant, research …

is_sample.description: true = made up for the demo story. Shown with a 'Sample listing' tag.

amount_period.description: How to read the amount. total_multi_year = the max is spread over several years (e.g. JRF up to $35,000 over four years).

num_awards.description: Awards per cycle when stated. null = unknown (odds formula defaults to 1).

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or "rolling". Never guess the year.

application_fee.description: Dollars. Anything above 0 is a scam signal and the listing is excluded (§7.4).

other.description: Anything else that adds effort: CSS Profile, research proposal, FAFSA …

is_sweepstakes.description: Lead-gen 'no-essay' giveaways. Hidden by default in results (§5.2).

published_applicants.description: Applicant count the provider published. null when not published.

selection.description: entitlement = everyone eligible who applies gets it (e.g. TAP). Show 'Open: if you qualify, you get it' instead of odds.

est_pool.description: Hand estimate of applicants per cycle for the odds formula (§6.2). Equals published_applicants when that exists.

est_pool_basis.description: How est_pool was reached, so judges can see it isn't made up.

citizenship.description: Statuses that may apply. [] = not stated (treat as open).

identity_groups.description: Self-identified groups the listing is limited to, e.g. first-gen, immigrant-or-child-of-immigrant, lgbtq. Students only see these matched if they chose to share them.

nyc_only.description: true = limited to NYC residents or NYC schools.

geo_scope.description: Widest area the listing is open to. Drives the default pool size (§6.2).

geo_areas.description: Named areas: Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island, NYC, NYS, NY/NJ/CT, US.

enrolled_at.description: Schools a student must currently attend. [] = any school. Card shows e.g. 'NYU students only'.

prerequisites.description: Things the student must have done to qualify (e.g. 'attended a hands-on engineering event'). These power the 'almost eligible' card: an opportunity's unlocks[] points here.

evidence.description: Short exact quotes from the source page for deadline, amount and eligibility. A field with no supporting quote stays empty.

field.description: Which field this supports: deadline, amount, eligibility, requirements, location, dates, cost …

page.description: URL the quote came from, when it isn't source_url.
